title: Best of Vietnam south to north in 14 days
summary: The 14-day spine in reverse: Ho Chi Minh City, the Mekong or Cu Chi, Hoi An, Hue, then Hanoi and one northern landscape.

days.title: Day 1 — Ben Thanh
days.body: Land in Ho Chi Minh City and walk the center.

days.title: Day 3 — Can Tho or Cu Chi
days.body: Go on to Can Tho, or to the Cu Chi tunnels if you are staying in the city.

days.title: Day 4 — Cai Rang
days.body: Be at Cai Rang at dawn if you came south.

days.title: Day 5 — Fly north
days.body: Fly from Ho Chi Minh City to Da Nang. The flight is about 1 hour 20 minutes.

days.title: Day 6 — Hoi An
days.body: Walk the old town from the Japanese Covered Bridge.

days.title: Day 7 — Hoi An Market
days.body: Visit Hoi An Market and eat cao lầu.

days.title: Day 8 — Hue
days.body: Travel to Hue and visit the citadel.

days.title: Day 9 — Hue tombs
days.body: Visit Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh.

days.title: Day 10 — Hanoi
days.body: Take the train or a flight to Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter.

days.title: Day 11 — Lake and citadel
days.body: Walk Hoan Kiem Lake and the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long.

days.title: Day 12 — Temple of Literature
days.body: Visit the Temple of Literature. The daytime adult ticket is 70,000 VND.

days.title: Day 13 — Ninh Binh or Ha Long
days.body: Take Trang An or a Ha Long boat, and do not do both.

days.title: Day 14 — Leave Hanoi
days.body: Return to Hanoi and fly home.

seoTitle: Vietnam in 14 days, south to north
seoDescription: Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi in 14 days, with the Mekong or Cu Chi, Hoi An, Hue, and one northern landscape.
